show.description: The show Reborn 70 follows Nobel Prize–winning doctor Ziya Sharma, who dies in a bombing but is mysteriously reborn in the body of a disgraced village mother in 2032. With her medical knowledge and new identity, she must fight prejudice, protect two children who hate her, and prove herself while uncovering dark conspiracies against her.
